_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Running your stocks through Buffett's rules…

description: Use this when the user shares several stocks they own or are watching (a portfolio, holdings, a watchlist, 'my stocks') and wants to know how good they are. Takes up to 25 tickers or company names and shows how many pass Buffett's test, how many of 7 legendary investors would buy each, and the strongest and weakest holdings. No login or personal data needed.

stocks.description: Up to 25 tickers or company names

name: check_portfolio
title: Check a portfolio against Buffett's rules
